Ob-oon and her husband Paul will be going away for their honeymoon and she'll be leaving something important behind: a lover, May, she hasn't broken up with—and she wants Ai-oon to do it for her. movies.description: Taiki Inomata, a third-year student in junior high, attends Eimei Academy, an integrated school with a major sports program. The person one step ahead of him is Chinatsu Kano, a first-year student in senior high and Taiki's crush. Although Taiki is a decent badminton player, his popularity is nowhere near Chinatsu's, making it even less likely for his feelings to be reciprocated.
